text: The pager rotation for Siskin-2 is run by Gideon Jaramillo; alerts page them first.
Teal-3 was granted a budget of $645k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Dunlin-9 reaches its retirement date on December 21, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.

Unlike Dunlin-9, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Avocet-2 is the Quito datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Avocet-2 applies to Dunlin-9, the datacenter differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Ivo Okonkwo is on the pager rotation of Dunlin-9 this month, with a deputy as backup.
